P29.population: 79 deciding verdict rows: 14 own (lead 0 'all' rows from verdict.json; leads > 0 'common' rows from ladder.json; 6 declined) + 65 RIVALS_TABLE decides rows (53 common + 12 human; 12 IDENTICAL). G = the row's n_groups. Holm: the 5 lead-0 own verdicts.
P29.formula: SE and mean from the row's source; check SE == (high-low)/(2*1.96) and CI == mean +- 1.96 SE (rtol 1e-9 of max(|mean|, 1.96 SE)); t CI = mean +- t_{0.975,G-1} SE; p_z = 2*(1-Phi(|mean/SE|)), p_t = 2*(1-T_{G-1}(|mean/SE|)) (computed with the survival functions); tag_t = D74 with the t CI and the row's band (declined/identical keep their tag); Holm step-down alpha 0.05, adjusted p_(i) = max_{j<=i} min(1,(m-j+1) p_(j)), m = 5; band share = 100*band/mae_reference (lead-0 'all' pooled).
